summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the Judo Klub Izola site (no backend calls). Verified Slovenian-by-default rendering, the 3-language flag switcher on all 4 routes, localStorage persistence, full translation coverage of every page (incl. the long O nas / 'Poletje na tatamiju' history section), the new 7-photo gallery event, the lightbox (prev/next/thumbnails/close), the two existing gallery events, mobile 390px behaviour, image loading and console errors. Also ran a programmatic key-parity diff of sl/en/it dictionaries (100% parity, no untranslated long strings). 1 HIGH functional/layout bug found: the lightbox thumbnail strip renders outside the viewport on desktop, making thumbnails unreachable for the 7-photo event.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog content overflows the viewport and cannot scroll, so the thumbnail strip is pushed below the fold. Measured: dialog scrollHeight 1194px vs viewport 1080px @1920x1080 (thumbnail-0 top=1098px => entire strip off-screen); 964px vs 768px @1366x768. Playwright normal click on thumbnail-6 of the 7-photo event times out ('element is outside of the viewport'). For the 3-photo event the strip is only half visible (top=1045, bottom=1109) so it clicks by luck. Root cause: fixed inset-0 flex column = header (~90px) + image max-h-[75vh] + caption card (~90px) + thumbnail row (~112px) > 100vh. Suggested fix: give the image area 'flex-1 min-h-0' with the img at 'max-h-full h-full object-contain' (drop max-h-[75vh]) and/or reduce to max-h-[55vh] and tighten the caption padding.

Duplicate data-testid values in the DOM: the switcher is rendered twice (desktop hidden md:flex + mobile flex md:hidden), so data-testid="language-switcher" and lang-sl/lang-it/lang-en each resolve to 2 elements. On mobile the FIRST match is the hidden desktop one, so a plain page.click('[data-testid="lang-it"]') fails with 'element is not visible'. Recommend distinct ids (e.g. lang-it-mobile) or rendering a single switcher.

Radix logs a console error on every lightbox open: '`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' (8 occurrences during the run). Wrap the existing <h3> in DialogPrimitive.Title or add a VisuallyHidden title.

Hardcoded Slovenian in non-visible text that is not translated: aria-label="Zapri"/"Prejsnja"/"Naslednja" (Galerija.jsx L184/198/229) and all img alt texts in Domov.jsx (L37,147,154,228,235,271), Footer.jsx, Navigation.jsx. Also <html lang> is never updated when the language changes (SEO/screen readers).

issues: Thumbnail strip completely off-screen (7-photo event) / clipped in half (3-photo event) - see HIGH bug above.
No scrolling possible inside the full-screen dialog, so the clipped content is unrecoverable for the user.
The px-20 horizontal padding leaves only ~351px for the photo while the prev/next round buttons are absolutely positioned on top of the image, overlapping the photo content.
Large empty grey area above the photo (image area is vertically centered but the caption block pushes it up), looks unbalanced.

action_items: HIGH: Fix Galerija lightbox vertical layout so the thumbnail strip is always visible/clickable at 1366x768 and 1920x1080 (use flex-1 min-h-0 + object-contain instead of max-h-[75vh], or reduce image max height).
MEDIUM: Make the language-switcher data-testids unique between the desktop and mobile instances (duplicate ids break automated clicks on mobile).
LOW: Add DialogPrimitive.Title (or VisuallyHidden) to the lightbox to silence the Radix a11y console error.
LOW: Translate aria-labels / img alt texts and set document.documentElement.lang on language change.
critical_code_review_comments: Galerija.jsx: events are derived with `g.events[meta.id]` and `text.photos[i]` with no guard - a missing id or a photo-count mismatch between EVENTS_META.photoUrls and a dictionary's photos array will throw and white-screen the page. Verified today that sl/en/it are in perfect parity (script /app/tests/i18n_keys_check.js), but add a fallback (`text?.photos?.[i] ?? {}`) to make it resilient.

LanguageContext.jsx: localStorage value is not validated against LANGS - a stale/invalid 'jki-lang' falls back to sl for `t` but `lang` state keeps the invalid code, leaving no flag highlighted. Sanitize the initial value.
LanguageProvider does not update <html lang> nor document.title per language.
Nav link `data-testid` is derived from the path (nav-link-o-nas) which is good and stable across languages - keep it that way.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Static React site, no backend. Preview URL from /app/frontend/.env. Gotchas for future scripts: (1) hero badge 'Dobrodosli' is uppercased by CSS, use case-insensitive assertions or inner_text lowercasing; (2) lang-sl/it/en exist TWICE in the DOM (desktop + mobile switchers) - on mobile use page.locator('[data-testid="lang-it"]').nth(1); (3) reset language between cases with page.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('jki-lang','sl')") + reload; (4) Radix DialogTitle console error is a known low-priority noise, filter it when asserting console errors. Already verified: SL default, EN/IT on all 4 routes, persistence, all 3 gallery events + lightbox nav, mobile menu, no broken images, i18n key parity. Re-verify the lightbox thumbnail visibility fix at 1366x768 and 1920x1080 by CLICKING thumbnail-0..6 (not just counting them).
rca_of_the_issue: Lightbox bug RCA: DialogPrimitive.Content uses 'fixed inset-0 flex flex-col' (height locked to 100vh, overflow not scrollable). Its children sum to more than 100vh because the middle area is 'flex-1 ... py-8' but the image inside is capped at max-h-[75vh] (=810px @1080) plus a caption card (~90px), on top of an ~90px header and an ~112px thumbnail footer -> 1194px total. Because flex-1 cannot shrink below its content, the thumbnail footer is laid out below the visible area and, with no overflow scroll, becomes permanently unreachable. Reproduction: open /galerija at 1920x1080 -> click event-card-poletje-na-tatamiju-2026 -> thumbnail-0 boundingBox().top = 1098 (> innerHeight 1080); page.click('[data-testid="thumbnail-6"]') times out with 'element is outside of the viewport'. Mitigation: replace max-h-[75vh] with 'min-h-0' on the flex-1 container + 'max-h-full object-contain' on the img so the image shrinks to the leftover space.
